limitations: Development cases informed local repair; no hidden holdout or statistical non-inferiority claim
Do not aggregate different candidate versions as repeats of the final version
A review finding count is not a quality score
Browser observations do not prove assistive technology speech, mobile device behavior, deployment or user approval
Raw local artifacts are not part of the promoted plugin
